vocab.cn_meaning: 课桌，办公室或教室里的小桌子
vocab.example: There are many desks in the room.
The seats are by the side of the pool.
Sara’s little shop is at the top of the stairs.
vocab.cn_example: 萨拉的小店在楼梯顶上。

vocab.example: Bill tells his dog to stay. It waits for Bill to come back.
vocab.cn_example: 比尔让他的狗待着别动。它等着比尔回来。

vocab.example: The beautiful lady talks to the man.
vocab.cn_example: 这位美丽的女士和那个男人说话。

vocab.example: He understands a house and car are expensive.
vocab.cn_example: 他知道房子和车都很贵。

vocab.definition: to use the legs to go from one place to another
vocab.cn_meaning: 走，用腿从一个地方走到另一个地方
vocab.example: He walks on this road to get home.
These birds fly east at this time of the year.
vocab.cn_example: 这些鸟在每年的这个时候向东飞。

vocab.definition: to behave in a certain way
vocab.example: They know how they must act in class.
vocab.cn_example: 他们知道在课上必须怎样表现。

vocab.definition: to take something to another place
vocab.cn_meaning: 带来，把某物带到另一个地方
vocab.example: She brings the food to the table.
They are glad they live in the city.
vocab.cn_example: 他们很高兴住在城市里。

vocab.example: He teaches a lesson about maps.
vocab.cn_example: 他教了一节关于地图的课。

vocab.definition: to use the ears to hear
vocab.example: She listens to a beautiful song.
She uses a pencil to write.

vocab.definition: a sentence that asks for an answer
vocab.example: The man asks a lot of questions.
vocab.cn_example: 这个男人问了很多问题。

vocab.example: She does not know the right answer.
Kayla’s mom teaches her how to grow a garden.
vocab.cn_example: 凯拉的妈妈教她如何种花园。

vocab.cn_meaning: 方法，某人做某事的方式
vocab.example: My mom shows me a way to cook eggs.
vocab.cn_example: 我妈妈教我一种做鸡蛋的方法。
